title: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly.
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, I often imagine standing nearby, watching quietly.
I see the palace filled with gold and authority… and a child lifted into royalty. The air feels heavy with ceremony. Power. Destiny. Silence.
Moses is clothed as a prince of Egypt — yet heaven already knows he belongs to something greater.
What must it have felt like to stand there, witnessing a future deliverer wrapped in privilege before being called into wilderness?

God can prepare a heart in places that seem far from His promises.
He can shape courage behind palace walls before revealing it in burning deserts.
I stand in the background — only a witness — watching how divine purpose often begins quietly, almost unnoticed.
Where might God be preparing me right now — in places that don’t yet look like calling?
